question.text: According to the SEBI Act, SAT shall endeavour to dispose of an appeal within what time period?

answer.text: Twelve months from the date of receipt of appeal
Six months from the date of receipt of appeal
Three months from the date of receipt of appeal
Nine months from the date of receipt of appeal

explanation.text: The Logic: The SEBI Act provides that an appeal filed before the Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT) shall be dealt with as expeditiously as possible and that endeavour shall be made to dispose of the appeal finally within six months from the date of receipt of the appeal. The Trap: Three months may sound expeditious, but the statutory endeavour period specified in the Act is six months. Twelve or nine months are not the figures used in the Act. Note: The six-month period is an endeavour, not a hard outer limit — the statute does not invalidate proceedings that take longer.
